_about: Vocabulary and query grounding for the reception software. Generated from a live inspection of the reception database; the generator is scripts/build_lexicon.py. Field names, codes, counts and catalogues are MEASURED. Human meanings and synonyms are hand-authored and marked as such. Nothing in this file may be typed from memory.

date.note: Zero-padded fixed-width Jalali sorts correctly as a string, so range filters work with plain >= and <=. This holds ONLY while every value is zero-padded ASCII; a Persian-digit or unpadded value breaks it silently. Month lengths: 1-6 have 31 days, 7-11 have 30, 12 has 29 or 30. '1405/07/31' does not exist -- a naive 1..31 range is short or empty in the second half of the year.
date.leap_year_warning: Use the 33-year cycle (ICU/CLDR), not the 2820-year Birashk cycle: they disagree about 1403, which IS a leap year. A converter on the wrong cycle mis-maps 1403/12/30 and every count near that boundary disagrees with the vendor's own reports by a day.

money.note: Integer Rial. Divide by 10 for Toman only at display time.

text_matching.rule: Never compare Persian text raw. Fold both sides. The live catalogue proves why: 'سي تي اسکن' (Arabic yeh, 206 services) and 'سی تی اسکن' (Persian yeh, 1 service) are stored as two different groups for one concept.
text_matching.fold: NFC, drop tatweel/harakat, digits to ASCII, yeh/kaf/heh/alef folded, ZWNJ to space, casefold
text_matching.squash: as fold(), plus all whitespace removed - use for entity lookup

live_only.note: Soft deletes. Measured cost of ignoring: 0.05% of counts (14 of 25,638).

patient.human: A person. One person over their whole history at the centre.
patient.note: Field names follow DICOM tag names, not the vendor's usual style. receptions also carries patientNameSnapshot and nationalCode inline - both PHI.

reception.human: One visit. A patient arrives, is registered, and is charged for one or more services.
reception.standard_ref: FHIR Encounter; DICOM Visit / Imaging Service Request
reception.grain_warning: A reception contains MANY services. Counting service rows and calling the result 'patients' is the defect that produced 76 and 24 when the true patient counts for 1405/06/01 were 62 and 22. Always count distinct ReceptionID for visits and distinct patient for people.

service.human: One billable examination performed during a visit.
service.standard_ref: DICOM Requested Procedure - 'the smallest unit of service that can be requested, reported, coded and billed' (PS3.3 sect 7.3); FHIR ServiceRequest.code / ChargeItem.code

modality.human: The class of imaging equipment: CT, MRI, ultrasound, radiography, bone density.
modality.three_vocabularies_warning: The SAME concept is written three different ways in this system: the numeric catalogue code ('3') on receptions, the DICOM code ('US') in studies.ModalitiesInStudy, and the Persian name ('سونوگرافی') in reports. A filter written in one vocabulary silently matches nothing in the other.

physician.human: Two different roles, and they are not the same person.

staff.software: ClinicWebsite.AdminUsers; receptions.registeredBy and transactions.registeredBy point here
staff.bridge_to_central_chat: AdminUsers.InoUserCode is the central chat 'Admin' id

transaction.human: One movement of money at the till.
transaction.standard_ref: HL7 v2 FT1; FHIR ChargeItem / PaymentReconciliation

report.human: The radiologist's written findings for a visit.
report.note: report.content is HTML and is PHI. Match on stripped text, never raw HTML.

study.human: The images themselves, as stored by PACS.

modality.storage_note: receptions.modality is USUALLY a string code but is SOMETIMES an embedded object. Measured on 1405/06/01: 201 string, 4 object. Any equality filter must therefore be {'$or': [{'modality': c}, {'modality._id': c}]} or it silently loses rows.

concepts.vendor_deviation: The vendor stores Modality='BD'. 'BD' is not a DICOM value: PS3.3 C.7.3.1.1.1 and CID 29 define BMD for X-ray bone densitometry and BDUS for the ultrasound variant. Query the vendor with 'BD'.

The vendor stores Modality='Mammography' -- the DICOM Code MEANING, not the code. Modality (0008,0060) has VR=CS, which permits only uppercase letters, digits, space and underscore, so a mixed-case value is not a conformant CS value at all. The DICOM code is MG. Compare case-sensitively against the literal string 'Mammography'.

insurance_type.storage_note: Coded strings '0'..'4' -- but the literal Persian word 'آزاد' also occurs as a value (1 reception in 1405). The field is not a clean enum.
insurance_type.meaning_is_inferred: The vendor exposes no lookup table for these codes. The meanings below are INFERRED from which per-insurer amount field is non-zero, and the evidence is recorded alongside each code. Treat as a strong hypothesis, not documented truth, until the vendor confirms.

transaction_insurance_type.collision_warning: SAME FIELD NAME, DIFFERENT VOCABULARY. receptions.insuranceType holds codes '1'..'4'; transactions.insuranceType holds words 'tamin', 'salamat', 'army'. A filter that works on one collection returns zero on the other.

service_group.spelling_warning: Groups are stored with mixed Arabic/Persian yeh. Fold before matching.

dicom_modality_in_study.note: DICOM codes, NOT the numeric catalogue codes. DOC and SR are documents and structured reports, not acquisition modalities -- excluding them is usually correct when counting examinations.

relationships.note: THE fan-out. Counting past this edge without DISTINCT is the classic error.

orphan_modality_codes_in_services.note: ServicesInfo references modality code(s) that the Modality catalogue does not define. A service under such a code resolves to a modality that cannot be named or filtered.

insurance_type_non_code_values.note: insuranceType is meant to be a numeric code but also holds a Persian word.

modality_stored_as_object.note: Any equality filter must cover both shapes.

study_date_two_formats.note: studies.StudyDate holds BOTH Gregorian YYYYMMDD ('20260823') and Jalali YYYYMMDD ('14050601'). A range filter written for one silently excludes the other.

service_group_spelling_split.note: Service groups are split by the Arabic/Persian yeh: 'سي تي اسکن' (206 services) and 'سی تی اسکن' (1) are one concept stored twice.

counting_rules._why: Every count question must name its grain. The standards keep these three levels separate and so must we.
counting_rules.invariant: services >= receptions >= distinct patients, for any period
counting_rules.ambiguity: 'چند نفر آمدند' is a patient question; 'چند تا مراجعه داشتیم' is a visit question. Staff use them interchangeably. When ambiguous, answer at the patient grain AND say which grain was used.
